facts.text: Park Hyatt Melbourne overlooks St. Patrick's Cathedral and Fitzroy Gardens.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking St. Patrick's Cathedral, Fitzroy Gardens, and the cosmopolitan mix of Victorian and modern architecture, Park Hyatt Melbourne offers exclusive, luxury accommodation in the heart of the city.

facts.text: The hotel is situated minutes from the Melbourne Cricket Ground and Rod Laver Arena.
facts.excerpt: Situated just minutes from the Melbourne Cricket Ground and Rod Laver Arena

facts.text: Fitzroy Gardens is two minutes from the hotel's doorstep.
facts.excerpt: Just two minutes from our doorstep, explore Fitzroy Gardens, a 26-hectare park that features a conservatory, picturesque statues and fountains, various cottages, a book shop and more.

facts.text: Parliament Train Station is a three-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Parliament Train Station is a 3-minute walk from the hotel.

facts.text: The lead-in guest rooms measure 48 square meters (517 square feet).
facts.excerpt: Spanning an impressive 48 square meters (517 square feet), our lead-in rooms offer more space than many suites elsewhere in the city .

facts.text: The hotel describes its standard guest rooms as the city's largest.
facts.excerpt: home to the city's largest standard guest rooms

facts.text: Rooms and suites blend art deco elegance with modern comfort, featuring wood-panelled walls.
facts.excerpt: Each is a blend of art deco elegance and modern comfort, featuring wood-panelled walls and rare luxuries like fireplaces and Juliet balconies.

facts.text: The Terrace Suite has an outdoor terrace with views of St. Patrick's Cathedral and a living room with a fireplace.
facts.excerpt: the Terrace Suite unveils a sweeping outdoor terrace boasting unmatched views of St. Patrick's Cathedral and the East Melbourne skyline. Nestled within are a plush king bed, a cosy living room with a fireplace

facts.text: Guest rooms have a separate walk-in shower and deep soaking tub.
facts.excerpt: Separate walk-in shower and deep soaking tub

facts.text: Standard rooms feature marble bathtubs, Le Labo toiletries and walk-in closets.
facts.excerpt: Marble bathtubs, Le Labo toiletries, and walk-in closets create a sense of indulgence that's rare in Australian hotels.

facts.text: The heated 25-metre pool sits beneath an Italian mosaic, with an adjoining sundeck.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in the tranquility of our heated, 25-metre pool set beneath an exquisite Italian mosaic. The adjoining sundeck completes this oasis of calm.

facts.text: The spa is on the 9th floor with six treatment spaces, including a couple's suite.
facts.excerpt: Ascend to our 9th-floor spa sanctuary that features six treatment spaces, including a couple's suite.

facts.text: The spa offers facials and massages plus hair and nail services.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in rejuvenating facials and massages, complemented by a selection of hair and nail services.

facts.text: The health club has a steam room, and the spa's signature treatment is a coconut body treatment.
facts.excerpt: Check out the heated indoor pool and steam room, then surrender to the spa's signature coconut body treatment.

facts.text: radii Restaurant serves a breakfast buffet and a la carte dishes such as Dutch Baby pancakes.
facts.excerpt: From a lavish buffet to à la carte favorites like free-range eggs, Dutch Baby pancakes, and smashed avocado, every dish is crafted with fresh, local ingredients

facts.text: radii Bar serves handcrafted cocktails, fine wines and premium spirits.
facts.excerpt: radii Bar invites you to unwind with handcrafted cocktails, fine wines, and premium spirits in an elegant yet relaxed setting

facts.text: The Lounge & Garden offers all-day dining and a signature high tea.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in our signature high tea for an elegant afternoon escape, or join us for a casual lunch or hearty dinner.

facts.text: High tea is served in an outdoor setting surrounded by greenery.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in an elegant high tea, set against a relaxed outdoor setting surrounded by greenery.

facts.text: Dogs are welcome, and each dog receives a plush bed, food and water bowls and a welcome treat.
facts.excerpt: Each dog enjoys a plush bed, food and water bowls, a welcome treat and exclusive access to our in-room dining menu for Very Important Pooches.

facts.text: The hotel has a resident dog named Charlie.
facts.excerpt: You may even spot Charlie, our resident pup and unofficial ambassador

facts.text: The ballroom supports up to 310 guests and the Library supports 50.
facts.excerpt: From our opulent ballroom that supports up to 310 guests to our intimate Library that supports 50

facts.text: Valet parking is available 24 hours for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking is available 24 hours for hotel guests at Park Hyatt Melbourne, with a clearance height of 2.1 meters.

facts.text: Wi-Fi at the hotel is free.
facts.excerpt: Unlike some big-chain hotels in Australia, the Park Hyatt's Wi-Fi is free.

facts.text: Club Rooms on the higher levels come with access to the Club Lounge.
facts.excerpt: Club Rooms on the higher levels command impressive views and come with access to the Club Lounge.

facts.text: Check-in is at 3:00 PM and checkout at 11:00 AM.
facts.excerpt: Check-In3:00 PM

facts.text: In-room dining is available until late.
facts.excerpt: Our in-room dining service is available until late

facts.text: Room service is 24 hours.
facts.excerpt: Room service is 24 hours

facts.text: The hotel is close to the boutiques of Collins Street.
facts.excerpt: We're also close to the exclusive boutiques of Collins Street.

contradictions.note: p3 lists in-room dining hours ending at midnight or 1am; p7 says room service is 24 hours

sources.excerpt: Our in-room dining service is available until late
